artworks.title: Gossiping Women
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: Three female figures are shown waist up, standing closely together. Each woman is depicted in a three-quarter view or profile, capturing their facial features. They are wearing flowing dresses or gowns. Two of the women have their hands together in a conversational pose. The background is plain, focusing on the trio. The drawing is in black and white with no color.

artworks.title: A Wounded Soldier and His Comrade
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an artistic sketch of two men's upper bodies. Both men are depicted from the side, facing to the right. The man in the foreground wears a cloth wrapped as a headscarf, covering his hair, and the other man wears a cap as well. Their facial features are outlined with sharp, dark strokes, and they both appear to have prominent cheekbones and elongated noses. The figures are dressed in clothing that is loosely sketched. The background is also sketched, with swirling lines and shapes that suggest a textured, abstract backdrop. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the figures.

artworks.title: L'Aventure du Vieux Doyen (The Adventure of the Old Dean)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and lithographic crayon wtih colored crayon and touches of white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring an elder figure being approached by a group in an interior setting. The figure is dressed in formal attire, holding a top hat. Surrounding him are other figures showing curiosity or admiration. One central figure is animatedly reaching towards the elder. In the background, another group appears intrigued, resembling an audience. Ornate wallpaper and stately columns decorate the setting.

artworks.title: Riders on the Metro
artworks.medium: black crayon on textured wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows a group of individuals seated in a room that resembles a train carriage. The figures are portrayed from the waist up, in seated positions. Their facial features are indistinct, with some expressions suggested through light and shadow. They wear headscarves and heavy clothing. The background features window structures, creating an enclosed space. The sketch has a raw and impressionistic style.

artworks.title: Sweepers
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and blue colored pencil on wove paper, partially silhouetted and laid down on a glossy gillot board, partially printed in a reticulated design, with additions by the artist in pen and black ink and blue colored pencil
artworks.description: The image shows four people walking in a line, slightly bent forward. The first person, a woman, wears a scarf, a long dress, and a coat. She carries a large broom. The second person is a bearded man wearing a hat, a long overcoat, and trousers, also carrying a broom. The third and fourth persons, both wearing hats and long coats, follow the same pattern, with the last person slightly hunched and stepping forward. They are all dressed in heavy garments. The background is sparse with a brown-toned area on the right and a textured section above that resembles a patterned sky or wall.

artworks.title: A Man on a City Street, Surrounded by Children (Un Père)
artworks.medium: black and blue crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of children surrounding a tall man in a long coat and hat. The man has a mustache and is walking slightly hunched forward, engaging with the children. The children are dressed in period clothing, with coats and hats. In the background, there is a building with a sign that reads “EPICERIE.” The scene is bustling, with additional figures in the background, suggesting a lively street setting.

artworks.title: In Love (Amoureux)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and blue colored pencil on wove paper, with the figure of the man partially silhouetted, the cityscape behind him drawn in pen and black ink with graphite and scratching out on gillot paper, inserted behind the figure  into a slit in the wove paper, and then glued down
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on a street. He is leaning slightly forward with one hand in his pocket and the other hanging by his side. The man has a pronounced nose and mouth, a light mustache, sideburns, and wears a wide-brimmed hat that mostly covers his hair. He is dressed in a long coat over a dark shirt and trousers, with visible shoes. The background depicts a city street at night or during dimly lit conditions, with other pedestrians, illuminated street lamps, and buildings visible.

artworks.title: The Blind Milton
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a stone bench. She has one arm on the back of the bench and the other in her lap. She has long, wavy gray or silver hair and is wearing a dark blouse with a white ruffled collar and cuffs, along with a long pinkish skirt. There are flowers around her and in pots nearby. The background includes an architectural setting with detailed stonework and a smaller figure peeking from behind a column. A tree is visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies with Angels and Cowering Figures (Illustration for Macklin's Bible?)
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and brown ink and touches of gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch features multiple figures in various states of completion, mostly showing upper bodies. The central figure is in a horizontal position, with arms extended. This person's facial features are delicately drawn, with a focused expression and long, flowing hair. Nearby, another head in profile with hair tied back is drawn with attention to detail. Across the image, several other figures can be seen in various positions, some appearing to be reclining while others are more abstract and blend into the background. Clothing details are minimal, with simple lines suggesting draped garments. No jewelry or definite objects appear to be held by any figures. The background is intentionally left plain, with light pencil markings giving it a textured look, enhancing the impression of movement within the drawing.

artworks.title: Jacob Allowing Benjamin to Go to Egypt with His Brothers
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and gray ink with gray-brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a room with several figures gathered around a reclining figure. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette primarily in sepia tones to create a dynamic composition. The central focus is on an elderly reclining figure on a bed, surrounded by other figures who appear attentive. The use of line and shading adds depth and texture to the characters' clothing and the draped fabric hanging above. One figure is prominently seated with a staff. The drawing suggests an emotional narrative, with gestures and expressions conveying tension or poignancy.

artworks.title: A Young Bull Grazing
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cow grazing in profile view. The drawing features pencil or charcoal strokes creating a sketchy style with soft shading and defined outlines. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray on a pale background. In the distance, a few trees are visible on the left, while a cow stands with its head down, focused on feeding. A tree frames the scene from the right with some branches sketched out.

artworks.title: A Rocky Hillside with Dead and Dying Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a natural scene with trees and rugged terrain viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The sketch-style drawing features loose brushstrokes and stippling techniques to show texture and movement. The color scheme is monochromatic with dark lines on a light background. The scene includes twisted tree trunks, branches, and rocks in the foreground, with more trees and rocks in the background that fade into lighter ink strokes, suggesting depth and distance.

artworks.title: A Scholar Writing
artworks.medium: red and graphite on tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper two-thirds of a man's body. He is standing, facing the viewer with his body angled slightly to the right. The man has facial features including a mustache and short, curly hair. He is wearing a loose-fitting garment with a prominent collar and buttons down the front. The man is holding a pen or similar writing instrument in his right hand, with his other hand resting on an open book or paper on a table in front of him. The background includes lightly sketched architectural elements. The drawing is in a neutral tone with fine details accentuated by red and black chalk strokes.

artworks.title: A Doorway in Ajaccio
artworks.medium: brush and gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a watercolor sketch with loose and fluid brushstrokes. The scene is captured at an angle, suggesting a view through an archway or entrance. In the distance, a darker rectangular shape could represent a doorway or window. The horizon is not clearly defined, and there is no distinct line between the sky and the structure. The color palette is limited to soft grays and browns, creating an understated, monochromatic look. The watercolor technique allows for a smooth transition between light and shadow, enhancing the atmospheric quality of the piece. Overall, the artwork conveys a quiet and minimalistic representation of an architectural feature, focusing on tonal values rather than detailed depiction.

artworks.title: The Murder of Archbishop Sharpe
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a coach, figures, horses, and landscape. The drawing shows an energetic encounter with various figures in motion or engaged in an activity. There is a coach in the center, horses attached, and figures gathered around. The background includes hills or mountains. The style features expressive lines and minimal shading.

artworks.title: The Four Fathers of the Church
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and brown wash, heightened with white gouache on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures, primarily from the waist up. In the center, an elder man with a long, flowing white beard and facial features partially obscured by shadows is wearing a papal tiara adorned with intricate designs. He holds a crosier-like staff in his hand. To his left, another elder figure with a mitre, a beard, and similar facial features leans in close. The figure on the left has bare arms and is muscular, with an attentive posture, resting one arm on a large book. Behind them, a figure in a mitre appears, holding another crosier, and a cherubic being with small wings raises its arms above. The entire scene is sketched with a focus on brown tones on a plain background, with slight architectural elements to the right.

artworks.title: A Chinese Peasant Selling Betel
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated sideways at a wooden table. He is leaning slightly forward, facing towards the viewer, with one hand on the table and the other holding a pipe. The man has a receding hairline, with hair pulled back into a bun. He wears a light blue tunic, light-colored pants, and slip-on shoes in a matching blue. On the table is an open container and a model or garden layout. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Standing Man Wearing a Great Coat and Boots
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man standing. He is facing slightly to the right and has a slight slouch. The man's facial features are drawn in a simple and expressive manner, with a pronounced nose and elongated face. His hair is curly and frames his head. He is wearing a long coat that falls below his knees, buttoned down the front, and loose sleeves with wide cuffs. The man is wearing boots that cover his legs up to the calves. The background is plain with no additional objects or patterns. The image is bordered by a sheet of paper that appears somewhat aged with slightly cut corners.

artworks.title: Campagna di Roma
artworks.medium: gray wash over traces of graphite on card
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape seen from an elevated perspective. On the left side, there are ruins of a structure with an arched doorway and tall trees. In the distance, mountains rise with a series of arches, possibly an aqueduct, running horizontally. The horizon is in the top third of the image. The artist used a wash technique with soft brushstrokes. The color palette is limited to shades of gray, accentuating light and shadow.

artworks.title: View of a Bay from a Hillside (Amalfi)
artworks.medium: black and gray wash with graphite on card
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape from an elevated point of view. The horizon is low with water meeting distant landforms. The scene is in a monochromatic palette of gray, with loose and fluid brushstrokes depicting the rugged terrain and water. Architectural structures or ruins are visible on the left, with trees and vegetation in front. In the distance, misty hills or cliffs can be seen.

artworks.title: Taggia
artworks.medium: black and gray wash with white gouache on card
artworks.description: The image shows a wide expanse of water leading to a distant landscape. The horizon line is high in the image, just below mountain peaks. The mountain range transitions from water to sky. The brushstrokes are soft and mimic natural contours. The color palette is primarily shades of gray with some lighter areas. Buildings are seen nestled into the mountains. The overall atmosphere is calm with minimal color contrast.

artworks.title: A Town on a Hilltop (Sanctuary of Lampedusa)
artworks.medium: gray wash with touches of pen and black ink on card
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains in the background. The brushstrokes are loose and capture the details of the trees and the building on the mountainside. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from light gray to deep charcoal. A small figure is visible on a path.

artworks.title: Figures Setting Out in Canoes from a Palm Grove (Wady Feiran)
artworks.medium: gray and black wash on card
artworks.description: The image shows tall palm trees clustered on the right side of a landscape. Near the foreground, a small boat with two figures is on a body of water. The water reflects the trees and figures. In the background, there are pointed mountain peaks meeting the sky. The horizon is low, marked by the distant mountains. The brushstrokes depict textures of palm fronds and tree trunks. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black, highlighting the natural elements in the scene.

artworks.title: River Winding through a Rock Formation (Philae, Egypt)
artworks.medium: gray wash on card
artworks.description: The image shows rock formations surrounding a body of water, viewed at water level. There is a lack of clearly defined horizon. The rocks have vertical lines, creating a sense of grandeur. The brushstrokes vary in texture, depicting the surfaces of the rocks. The color scheme is mainly grayscale, using light and shadow for depth. Watercolors are used for a subtle, naturalistic appearance with gentle contrast.
